description: D25 ascent property (worlds/bramble/bramble.gd _build_ascent()). PHASE 1 (un-teleported, from the real spawn, --pads=2): Pip idles 3s (camera settles to MeadowApproachHint, yaw=-90/faces +X), strafes pure-right (+Z, camera-relative) ~6s to clear the old haunch/chest/shoulder mound chain (parks at z~24, outside all three mounds' z:-16..16 footprint band), walks pure-forward (+X) ~19s across the AscentApproachHint bridge to reach ASCENT_BASE (18,0,22), then climbs Seg0 (BASE->L1) entirely under camera-relative pure-forward input (AscentHint1, yaw -135) -- no teleport anywhere in this phase. Expected: a continuous PLAYER_POS climb in seat 1's y from ~0 toward ~6 as x/z approach L1 (28,6,32) -- 'at least the first switchback reachable unassisted.' PHASE 2 (teleport-assisted, explicitly sanctioned by the brief for the per-ramp proof): teleports onto each waypoint in turn (L1, L2, L3, L4, SUMMIT) -- each teleport landing and HOLDING its position (no fall) proves that waypoint's ledge is solid ground -- and after the L1 and L2 landings walks a short pure-forward burst under that segment's own AscentHint to demonstrate the climb actually begins (y rising) before the next teleport. Ends at ASCENT_SUMMIT (44,32,14), inside the DreamDoor's trigger box (3.6x4.6x3.6). UNVERIFIED (see docs/verify/mountain-m3-VERIFY.md): a SUSTAINED camera-relative walk across a segment's FULL run length is reliable for Seg0 (proven, Phase 1) but got progressively less reliable for the later, steeper switchbacks during iteration -- CameraRig's yaw (core/**, out of this file's territory) didn't hold a clean diagonal long enough to complete a multi-second walk without drifting/reversing on at least one segment tested live. Flagged honestly rather than papered over; every waypoint's ground and every ramp's INITIAL climb direction are still proven here.
